trickyParts: GitHub lists a re-run attempt's kept jobs under new job ids with run_attempt equal to the new attempt and the earlier attempt's step times (verified on run 39304834688 attempt 2). The plan's run_attempt filter excluded nothing; checkDeployRun now counts a step only when its started_at is not before the attempt's run_started_at, so a kept Apply does not wake the check a second time.

The coalescing rule is unchanged: one pending cause; a later wake while one is kept is ignored and its fact id is recorded, which is lossless because the next look reads production after every ignored deploy finished.
A deploy row carries no build; rows queued before this change decode as before (build only).
deviations: Plan decision 6's 'a job of an earlier attempt listed under this attempt is ignored' rests on run_attempt; real GitHub data contradicts it, so the kept-job test uses run_started_at instead (fix commit 1e00c2e1).

Acceptance row 5 (older run): no release.yaml re-run attempt fits, so the live proof uses a real older-head attempt-1 run (40177490116) and the rig's case (e); the re-run variant is proven live only as its negative (kept job of 39304834688 attempt 2 wakes nothing).
The preview-only run (Apply skipped) is proven by the rig and outbox tests only: no real release.yaml run skips the configured step.
Simplify pass removed WorkflowRunCompleted.HeadSHA (unused) and reduced deployRunCompleted to the one deploy config can match.
Test fixtures use placeholder repositories (acme/infra), per the repository's private-name rule.
